summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 validation (Slate Navy theme, Light/Dark toggle, Login demo panel, redesigned Mitarbeiter dashboard, Users copy buttons, receipt regression). All major flows work in the new theme. Verified for admin@repair.de, mohini@repair.de and chris@repair.de using demo login panel.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. A dynamic-instrumentation <span> is being injected inside <option> elements of the part-select dropdown (line ~342). Visual functionality unaffected, but noisy console error on every order detail page.

data-testid `cost-breakdown` and `used-parts` NOT present on order detail page (visibility check failed). Testing spec expected them. Please add them to the cost breakdown and used-parts sections so future regression tests can target them.

action_items: Fix React hydration warning caused by <span> being rendered inside <option> in OrderDetail.jsx (part-select). Likely due to a dev-only injection wrapping option children; ensure options only render plain string content.
Add missing data-testid attributes `cost-breakdown` and `used-parts` on OrderDetail sections.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext + ThemeToggle implementation is clean; correctly toggles `dark` class on <html>, persists to localStorage `rb_theme`, defaults to dark.
Login demo panel is well structured with data-testid for every row, use-, copy-, copy-password buttons. Password hint uses shared DEMO_PW constant.
Abholschein correctly forced to white background + black text via inline style (verified computed style rgb(255,255,255) / rgb(0,0,0)), shows Auftrag + Druckdatum in Europe/Berlin.
MitarbeiterDashboard reuses api.get('/orders') and derives all KPIs client-side; slicing to 12 is fine for the widget.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all critical flows PASS; 2 minor missing testids + 1 hydration warning)

test_credentials: admin@repair.de / Repair2026!, mohini@repair.de / Repair2026!, chris@repair.de / Repair2026! (from demo panel)
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seed (29 orders, 11 users incl. TEST users, 5 branches).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 was frontend theme+UX. Verified: (1) Demo login panel expand + use-<email> fills form + login works, (2) theme-toggle switches `dark` class on <html>, persists to localStorage rb_theme, both modes render without layout break, (3) Mitarbeiter dashboard for mohini shows kpi-total=19, kpi-inprogress=3, kpi-ready=2, kpi-waiting=15, qa-new-order/qa-scan/qa-whatsapp buttons, see-all-orders link, and 12 ma-order-<num> rows; row-click navigates to order detail, qa-new-order goes to /auftrag/neu, see-all to /auftraege, (4) Admin dashboard renders metric-total/active/sla/revenue + revenue-chart in themed style, (5) Techniker (chris) dashboard renders (AdminTechDashboard variant) with metrics 19/15/0/2, no errors, works in both light and dark, (6) /benutzer shows 11 copy-user-<email> buttons + Repair2026! password hint, (7) /auftraege 29 rows with Filiale/Mitarbeiter/Techniker columns, order detail shows whatsapp-fab, audit-list, open-receipt; open-receipt opens modal with print-receipt-button + download-pdf-button and #abholschein is white/black with dates. Minor issues: (a) React hydration warning on part-select option children (dev instrumentation adds <span> inside <option>); (b) data-testid `cost-breakdown` and `used-parts` are not present on order detail page despite being in spec.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues. Hydration warning stems from a dev-only x-source instrumentation injecting <span style=display:contents> into <option> children in OrderDetail.jsx part-select (line 342). HTML spec disallows any element besides text inside <option>, hence the warning. Fix: ensure part options render only string values (e.g. {`${p.brand} ${p.name}`} as a single string expression) so instrumentation doesn't wrap children.
